title: Finite flat scalar-model resolutions on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], $R$ a commutative ring, $R_{\mathcal C}$ its constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and $B$ a sheaf of commutative $R_{\mathcal C}$-algebras. Let $P$ be a finitely presented $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], and write $M=B\otimes_{R_{\mathcal C}}P_{\mathcal C}$, using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. If $R$ is a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] and $B$ is flat as an $R_{\mathcal C}$-module [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], there are finite integers $m,n\geq0$ and an exact sequence $0\to B^m\to B^n\to M\to0$. The resulting two-term complex represents $M$ in the unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and for every $B$-module sheaf $N$ its derived tensor with $M$ is represented by $[N^m\to N^n]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$. If $R$ is a field, no flatness assumption on $B$ is necessary: $M\cong B^r$ for some finite $r\geq0$, and $M\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}N\cong N^r$ in degree zero. Derived tensor is computed using K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex].

proof.text: For $R$ a DVR, apply [lem-sfb-scalar-finite-free-resolutions] to a finite presentation of $P$. It gives finite $m,n$ and $0\to R^m\xrightarrow{A}R^n\to P\to0$.

source.place: Local models, scalar finite free resolution, exact scalar extension and tensor calculation

proof.text: The given flatness of $B$ over $R_{\mathcal C}$ permits [lem-sfb-constant-finite-free-presentation-extension] to turn this into $0\to B^m\xrightarrow{A_B}B^n\to M\to0$. Apply the exact-sequence augmentation clause of [lem-sfb-ringed-finite-free-resolution-tensor]. This very two-term complex represents $M$, is K-flat, and computes its derived tensor with each $N$ as $[N^m\xrightarrow{A_N}N^n]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$.

source.place: Local models, scalar finite free resolution, exact scalar extension and tensor calculation

proof.text: For $R$ a field, [lem-sfb-scalar-finite-free-resolutions] supplies an isomorphism $R^r\to P$ for finite $r$. The isomorphism clause of [lem-sfb-constant-finite-free-presentation-extension] gives $B^r\cong M$; that clause imposes no flatness assumption on $B$.

source.place: Local models, scalar finite free resolution, exact scalar extension and tensor calculation

proof.text: Apply the degree-zero augmentation and tensor formula of [lem-sfb-ringed-finite-free-resolution-tensor] to $B^r[0]\to M[0]$. This is a K-flat resolution and gives $M[0]\otimes_B^{\mathbf L}N[0]\cong N^r[0]$ for every $N$.
